name: How long does it take to repair a water leak under concrete?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a water leak under concrete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a water leak repair under concrete depends on the specific repair method chosen and the complexity of accessing the leak. Simple spot repairs might be completed within a day or two once the leak is located. More extensive work, such as rerouting pipes or significant concrete removal and replacement, could take several days. Leak detection itself can take a few hours. We prioritize efficient and thorough service to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a day for simple spot fixes to several days for complex rerouting, depending on the leak's accessibility and repair method.
